binary_encoding.layout: [uint16 BE token_count][uint16 BE token ids in sequence order, count entries][fields section: for each token id in the same order, uint32 BE byte-length followed by that many UTF-8 bytes of the canonical JSON (sorted keys, no whitespace) of the token's field object; tokens with no fields encode an empty object {}]
binary_encoding.note: Two implementations that build the same token id list with the same field objects produce byte-identical output. Field objects are the kind_tables field sets; absent optional fields are omitted from the JSON, never null.

control_tokens.name: SNAPSHOT_SEP
control_tokens.role: separator between state snapshot and action menu

control_tokens.name: ANNOT_SEP
control_tokens.role: separator between edge list and annotation list

control_tokens.name: MENU_SEP
control_tokens.role: separator between annotation list and valid-action menu

description: Typed-token encoding of canvas state and the valid-action menu. This is the System-1 model's input language. Token ids are fixed; the field tables are canonical JSON (sorted keys, no whitespace, UTF-8). Any change to a token id, a field layout, or the ordering rule bumps encoding_version and forces retraining.

fields.name: x
fields.type: integer, 40-600 (guide coordinates rounded, round half up)

fields.name: y
fields.type: integer, 40-380 (guide coordinates rounded, round half up)

kind_tables.name: node
kind_tables.token_id_rule: 32 + slot_index, where slot_index is the position of the node in node-id sort order (n1 -> slot 0, n2 -> slot 1, ...)

fields.name: a
fields.type: node slot_index of the source node

fields.name: b
fields.type: node slot_index of the target node

kind_tables.name: edge
kind_tables.token_id_rule: 96 + slot_index, where slot_index is the position of the edge in (a, b, cat) sort order; a and b compared as node slot indices, cat compared alphabetically (contact < marketing < payment)

fields.name: node_slot
fields.type: node slot_index the annotation attaches to

kind_tables.name: annotation
kind_tables.token_id_rule: 160 + slot_index, where slot_index is the position in (node_slot, kind) sort order, ties broken by canonical payload JSON byte order (UTF-8). Retention payload: {record_type, range_min_years, range_max_years, statute, as_of} or {record_type, verify_only: true, as_of}, plus optional anchor. Confirmation payload: {note, item_index}. Review-flag payload: {reason, item_index or null}.

fields.name: action_name
fields.type: string, one of the action-catalogue action names

fields.name: params_digest
fields.type: first 8 hex chars of SHA-256 over canonical params JSON

kind_tables.name: action_menu
kind_tables.token_id_rule: 224 + slot_index, where slot_index is the position of the action in action_name alphabetical order, ties broken by params_digest

menu_grounding.description: The menu is a closed deterministic function of (recipe item at item_index, session state). Entries: the current recipe item's intent grounded with its exact params from the recipe; plus recovery entries: undo_last (present iff at least one applied, non-tombstoned mutating action exists), skip_recipe_item (target fixed to the current item_index), flag_for_review (unparameterized; targets the current item by default), abort_session (always present). At most 5 entries, so the 64 slots can never overflow.

ordering_rule.note: This ordering is load-bearing: two independent implementations must serialize the same canvas to the same token sequence. Separators (SNAPSHOT_SEP, ANNOT_SEP, MENU_SEP) are always emitted even when a section is empty. Node/edge/annotation counts past 64 slots are rejected loudly at recipe load per the size limits; the encoder never wraps or truncates silently.
sequence: node tokens in node-id sort order (n1, n2, ... n10; numeric sort, not lexicographic)
edge tokens in (a, b, cat) sort order
annotation tokens in (node_slot, kind) sort order
action-menu tokens: the valid actions at this step, in action_name alphabetical order
ordering_rule.snapshot_example: [BOS, node(n1), node(n2), SNAPSHOT_SEP, edge(n1->n2), ANNOT_SEP, annot(retention on n2), MENU_SEP, action(connect), action(export), action(set_retention), EOS]

vocab_accounting.usable_note: Phase 0 uses 5 control + 27 spare control + 64 node + 64 edge + 64 annotation + 64 action-menu = 288 ids. The rest of the 16-bit space is reserved for later phases (field-level tokens, undo-history tokens, multi-canvas tokens).
